title: Committed compiled binary app.bin (2MB Mach-O arm64) to the repo
evidence: git show 0118cc0 --stat: " app.bin              | Bin 0 -> 2057480 bytes"; file app.bin: "app.bin: Mach-O 64-bit executable arm64"; git ls-files includes "app.bin"
detail: The 0118cc0 polish commit added a built platform-specific binary; the round briefing names 'committed app.bin binary' a legitimate blocker-class finding. Build artifacts bloat the repo and are platform-specific; .gitignore does not cover it.
recommended_fix: git rm --cached app.bin, add app.bin (and equivalent build outputs) to .gitignore, and note the build command in README instead.

title: E1 reroute-branch test cannot distinguish rerouted-packet survival from fresh-spawn deliveries
detail: The assertion only checks deliveries continue after demolish — with 30/tick flooding, fresh spawns via the alt path deliver even if every mid-edge packet were dropped. sev_drops_before is computed then discarded, so E1's reroute branch is not actually pinned.
recommended_fix: Track ids/edge positions of packets mid-edge at demolish and assert some deliver (or assert severance drops < occupancy at demolish).
